violation_type.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Hold if Unable to Sit (26 TAC §746.2419(2))
violation_type.short_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Hold if Unable to Sit
violation_type.typical_finding: There was a 6 month old infant laying down in the crib drinking a bottle and was not holding it very well.  (NOTE:  The caregiver picked up the infant to feed him and hold his bottle.)

finding_variants.text: There was a 6 month old infant laying down in the crib drinking a bottle and was not holding it very well.  (NOTE:  The caregiver picked up the infant to feed him and hold his bottle.)
Infant child age thirteen months was observed laying down on a pillow while drinking a bottle.

Infants were observed lying in cribs while holding their own bottles and feeding themselves. One infant younger than 12 months was observed lying on a Boppy pillow inside the crib while holding a bottle and feeding himself.
